note: Held tier-5 English Wikipedia compilation for the B1 Centauro. The registry marks primary_held false because the article is a secondary compilation. It publishes the Centauro 1 mass, length, width and height, the engine model and rating of 520 hp with no net basis, the hydropneumatic automatic transmission gear counts, the wheel arrangement, the maximum road speed and the road range. It publishes no ground clearance, no tyre size, no torque and no grouser statement, so the entry is not runtime-ready.
